name: Kwame Owusu
comment: Maa Annah's goat meat light soup cured my cold instantly! The fufu is freshly pounded with zero lumps, silky and smooth in the hot Asanka bowl. Generous chunks of soft tender goat meat and aromatic prekese. Best chop bar in Ghana, bar none!

name: Akosua Mansah
comment: Their morning Waakye is simply unmatched! Hot leaves aroma, soft braised wele, talia spaghetti, rich gari foto, and dark fiery shito. When you visit on Friday, make sure to get there early before the pot finishes!

name: Uncle Ebo Mensah
comment: The Charcoal-Grilled Volta Tilapia with hot Banku is pure joy. The raw pepper ground inside the apotoyewa with sliced onions is on another level. Wash down with cold sweet Palm Wine or chilled Sobolo. Chop time, no friend!

name: Abena Serwaa
comment: The Kokonte ('Face the Wall') with creamy groundnut soup and smoked catfish brought back childhood memories of Kumasi. Maa Annah always scoops extra soup with a warm motherly smile. Authentic Ghanaian hospitality!
